title: STEER: Reducing Inference Cost in Relational Foundation Models through Semantically Informed Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.00907v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Relational foundation models (RFMs) are pretrained once on a collection of relational databases and prediction tasks, and then applied zero-shot to previously unseen databases and tasks. To make a prediction for a target row, an RFM samples a neighborhood of rows linked to that row through foreign keys and uses this neighborhood as its inference context. Lowering inference cost is an important goal for any foundation model, and for RFMs this cost grows with the size of the context. The simplest ways to shrink the context is to drop some of the sampled rows, but this ignores the semantics of the database schema, so it is as likely to discard informative rows as uninformative ones. We propose STEER, a sampling approach that shrinks the inference context by concentrating it on the tables most relevant to the prediction task at hand. translated_title: STEER：通过语义感知采样降低关系型基础模型的推理成本
translated_abstract: 关系型基础模型（RFMs）在一组关系型数据库和预测任务上进行一次性预训练，随后以零样本方式应用于之前未见过的数据库和任务。为了对目标行进行预测，RFM会采样通过外键与该行相连的行邻域，并将该邻域用作推理上下文。降低推理成本对任何基础模型来说都是重要目标，而对RFM而言，该成本会随着上下文规模的增大而增长。缩小上下文最简单的方法是丢弃部分采样行，但这种方式忽略了数据库模式的语义，因此其丢弃信息性行的可能性与丢弃非信息性行的可能性相同。我们提出了STEER，这是一种采样方法，通过将推理上下文集中于与当前预测任务最相关的表来缩小推理上下文。STEER通过提示大语言模型对模式中的外键边进行排序来获取相关性信息。
tldr: STEER通过利用大语言模型对数据库模式的外键边进行语义相关性排序，将推理上下文集中于与预测任务最相关的表，从而在保持预测效果的同时降低关系型基础模型的推理成本。
en_tdlr: STEER reduces inference cost in relational foundation models by prompting an LLM to rank foreign-key edges by semantic relevance, thereby concentrating the inference context on the tables most relevant to the prediction task.
